name: currencyguard-guard-pricing
tagline_zh: 发票外币报价前，先查汇率保护价和结算日。不成交、不荐股，只给透明数据——像给跨境合同戴了安全套。
tagline_en: Check FX protection prices and settlement dates before invoicing—no trades, no advice, just transparent data.
desc_en: Use CurrencyGuard's public MCP to price and explain invoice-linked FX protection, inspect rates, and resolve settlement dates without executing trades or giving financial advice.
why_zh: 同类工具只给汇率，它直接算好保护成本并解析结算日，且明确不碰交易，专治报价时的汇率焦虑。
why_en: Unlike rate-only tools, it prices protection and resolves settlement dates without executing trades—curing invoice FX anxiety.
